basis: Defining skin disease and carcinoma; tooth loss and multinodular goiter each reported in 1/2 patients. Conjunctival telangiectasia does not establish ocular damage.
Defined by nystagmus with head nodding and torticollis; associated movements do not establish separate neurologic or musculoskeletal damage.
Immune-mediated inflammatory bowel disease; no evidence of common direct extraintestinal organ damage for this subtype.
Urethral/renal defects support urinary involvement; cortical atrophy, cardiomyopathy and skeletal malformations each annotated 80-99%. Genital transposition itself has no axis.
Intracranial arterial embolic obstruction causing ischemic stroke; both the vessel lesion and resulting brain injury define the disease.
Sarcoma originating in mesenchymal soft tissue; no specific additional organ of origin or common direct organ involvement is established.
Inherited VWF dysfunction impairs platelet adhesion and haemostasis; bleeding sites do not establish additional intrinsic organ disease.
Inherited vitreoretinal disease with abnormal retinal vascular development, exudation and retinal detachment; manifestations remain within the eye.
Carcinoma originates in the supraglottic larynx, which belongs to the airway axis.
Necrosis directly destroys kidney cortical tissue; the various underlying causes do not establish other organ involvement.
Inherited retinal degeneration causes night blindness, impaired colour vision, scotomas and reduced visual acuity.
Spinal dysraphism with cystic herniation of the dilated spinal cord central canal through a vertebral defect; additional organ damage is not established as common.
Benign endobronchial epithelial tumour occupying the airway and commonly causing bronchial obstruction; infection is not required across the group.
Combined immunodeficiency; recurrent respiratory infections, thrush and mucosal ulcers do not establish persistent additional organ damage.
Seizures occurred in 2/2 patients and developmental delay in 1/2; facial morphology and psychiatric manifestations do not establish additional organ damage.
Primary malignant bone tumour with destructive osteolytic lesions; reactive blood-count changes do not establish haematologic disease.
Skin hyperextensibility and fragility together with generalized joint hypermobility define this EDS group; bruising alone does not establish a coagulation disorder.
Myotonic muscle disease; cognitive/learning impairment commonly exceeds 30%; cardiac conduction disease and cataracts each exceed 30% over the lifelong course.
Acute megakaryoblastic leukemia affects marrow and blood cells; Down syndrome manifestations belong to the underlying separate syndrome.
Abnormal otic-capsule bone remodelling causes hearing impairment; this localized ear disease does not establish generalized skeletal involvement.
Congenital ichthyosis with scaling, hyperkeratosis and erythroderma; the causal enzyme does not by itself establish systemic metabolic disease.
Chronic infection directly affects skin and peripheral nerves; associated denervation muscle atrophy is annotated 30-79%. Ocular and upper airway damage are below 30%.
Benign epidermal neoplasm confined to skin, with epidermolytic hyperkeratosis and papillomatosis.
Pulmonary arteriolar vasculopathy causes elevated vascular resistance and right-heart failure; intrinsic airway or lung-parenchymal damage is not required.
Pressure-associated avascular necrosis directly destroys bone; proposed nitrogen embolism does not establish a separate generalized vascular disorder.
